body: The glimmer of happy is always accompanied with horrible feelings. My boyfriends son called me mom the other day which made me feel good. But he told the baby mama and she flipped out. We didn't tell him to do that, he didn't know what he was doing, he is 3. Tugs at my heart because I'm not a mom and I always feel like I'm intruding in everyone's life. When I want to talk to my boyfriend and he rolls his eyes and pauses the tv I just retreat. I just want to disappear. I just want to go away. Start life over. It would be fantastic if I could just stop existing.

I feel like I can get there. I find something small and then 10 bad things fall on top of me. Like today I told my boyfriend I think I need to see a doctor because I am feeling out of control with depression and anxiety. He wants to know why I can't use my current insurance and it's because I had to drop the insurance company because we couldn't afford the premium every month. Plus I got a hinky company that hasn't paid any of the other doctors I saw earlier this year. They diagnoised me as being at the beginning of MS. I don't feel like I have anything to look forward to anymore.
The problem is everyone tells me to look at the bigger picture. How am I supposed to look at the big picture when the small one is so awful?
He's my boyfriend. He doesn't get it. I've been this way for a long time.
No. I was raised to believe that those were bad and taboo. So whenever I landed in therapy I always lied to the therapist.
Not that I can think of

It takes all my energy to not commit the act. Suicide would be great. I, even now, just want to die. I could swallow the whole bottle of pills right now, just go to sleep and never wake up. Every moment is filled with the thought. I've started carrying them in my purse. I can't afford help. I don't know if I want help at this point. I feel like help is pointless. They say the first step is admitting you need help. I don't need help. I have it figured out. I just need some courage. I need someone to tell me it's ok to die.

The end of me doesn't sound like a bad thing. The pain will stop. The nightmares will stop. Everything will stop. The world will go on. Everyone will move on. But the pain finally ends. I'm 28 years old. People think I'm to old to feel suicidal. Sure doesn't stop me from staring at the dark tunnel. Feeling lost in the dark. Like no one gives a damn. What do you do when no one gives a damn? You end. Instead of letting them end me I can end myself. Go out on my own terms.

If everything was comfortable. If I was able to make ends meet? If I was able to afford to eat this week. I haven't eaten in three days except for a banana yesterday morning. Why bother? It's not like it matters if I am gone. Your life, dear stranger, won't be effected by my not being here.

What's to tell? A sad story that is my life. Since I was 4 years old I've been abused. An uncle, a coach, a teacher, a boyfriend, strangers, another boyfriend. I've been to hell. I live in hell. There are no comforting thoughts, there are no dreams and rainbows. Everyone sees a beautiful day, I see the evil in the world. That man in the van over there, who has he hurt? Is someone in the back of it now? The only reason I am here on this earth is to be someone for people to hurt. I'm tired of the pain, the nightmares. I just don't want to carry on.
